regions.contentLimits: One brand link and three navigation targets.
regions.overflow: Navigation wraps to a second line on narrow viewports and stays right aligned.

regions.contentLimits: One eyebrow, one h1 under 60 characters, one lead under 160 characters, three actions, and one phone-framed still of the demo with its photograph credit.
regions.overflow: Actions wrap. The phone frame shrinks to the column width and never exceeds the phone container token; the credit line wraps beneath it.
Links wrap with row and column gaps.

responsive.compact: Hero stacks to one column with the poster below the copy, and navigation wraps.
responsive.wide: Hero is a two-column grid with the poster beside the copy.

focus.onError: Not applicable; the route has no form.

accessibility.headings: One h1 for the product promise. No h2 on this route.
accessibility.labels: Every action is a link with visible text. The brand mark and the phone frame furniture are decorative and hidden. The hero photograph has descriptive alternative text and a visible credit with license and source links.
